$comment: Local negative cache invalidation key. verdictRevision = FNV-1a 32-bit over the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical JSON of the verdict entry, lowercase hex zero-padded to 8 chars. Canonical JSON: only the fields state, reasonCode, wireFamily, sourceRefs; keys in lexicographic order; absent or null fields omitted; sourceRefs sorted ascending; no whitespace. A missing verdict (null) is hashed as {"state":"unknown"}. Each end runs one test per case and asserts both canonical and revision.
